user.title: iKuai Router
user.description: Connect to an iKuai router (official iKuaiOS 4.x OpenAPI). Enable the API switch first in the router web admin (System Settings -> API integration) and generate a token. The address accepts 192.168.1.1, https://192.168.1.1 or a host with a custom port.

data.name: Name
data.verify_ssl: Verify TLS certificate (turn off for the self-signed router certificate)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter token
reauth_confirm.description: The token expired or was regenerated. Please enter the new API token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the router, check the address

init.title: iKuai settings
init.description: Change the router address, token and polling options at any time. Write support is off by default: turn it on AND pick the rule groups you want to expose as switches.

data.enable_write: Enable write operations (switches and action buttons)

block_terminal.name: Block terminal
block_terminal.description: Add a terminal to the MAC blacklist so it cannot access the internet. Requires enabling write support in the integration options.

expires_hours.name: Auto-expire (hours)
expires_hours.description: Hours until the rule expires; leave empty for permanent

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Target router when multiple iKuai entries exist

allow_terminal.name: Allow terminal
allow_terminal.description: Remove all blacklist rules for this terminal. Requires write support.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC of the terminal to unblock

parental_control.name: Parental control
parental_control.description: Block internet access for a terminal on a weekly schedule (creates a drop ACL rule with a time template). Requires write support.
